sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: Sisi Alero Fintech Innovations (Sisi Alero Pay App Nigeria Limited) is a leading financial technology company based in Owerri Municipal, Nigeria. Founded and led by experienced Digital Payments Strategists, we are committed to driving financial inclusion across Nigeria by providing accessible, secure, and innovative digital payment solutions. Our platform enables individuals, small businesses, and enterprises to conduct financial transactions with confidence, speed, and efficiency. We understand the unique challenges of the Nigerian financial landscape and have built our solutions to address them directly. From peer-to-peer transfers to merchant payments, bill settlements to airtime purchases, Sisi Alero Pay simplifies every financial interaction. Our mission is to empower every Nigerian with the tools they need to participate fully in the digital economy, regardless of location or economic status.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Digital Wallet Solutions: Secure mobile wallet for storing funds, making payments, and receiving money instantly across Nigeria.

Merchant Payment Processing: Enable your business to accept digital payments from customers through QR codes, payment links, and POS integration.

Bill Payment Services: Pay utility bills, cable TV subscriptions, internet services, and government fees directly from your wallet.

Airtime & Data Top-Up: Instantly recharge airtime and purchase data bundles for all Nigerian networks at competitive rates.

Peer-to-Peer Transfers: Send money to family, friends, and business partners across Nigeria in seconds with zero hassle.

Business Payment APIs: Integrate our secure payment gateway into your platform with our developer-friendly APIs and comprehensive documentation.

Financial Analytics: Access detailed transaction reports and financial insights to make informed business decisions.

Agent Banking Network: Join our growing network of agents and earn commissions while serving your community.
